svg.title: Short decode：L0 59.38、Direct 58.48、SYCL 42.05 tok/s；另列 2K prefill
svg.desc: Windows A770 16GB / Xeon E5-2696 v4 / 256 GiB DDR3, driver 32.0.101.9034, oneAPI 2025.3, 2026-11-05. Lead example: 2026-11-04 frozen Short28/natural76 decode, ten warmups and five retained per process. SYCL/Direct/SYCL bracket gives Direct +39.07%; independent L0 is +41.21% versus that SYCL cross-cohort baseline. These Short figures are not current-U4 measurements. Separate 2048-input/128-output Code and Prose prefill panels follow. SYCL native is the corrected FP16 paired-M4 engine measured 2026-11-04; current U4/min16/M16/HC256 L0 comes from the independent 2026-11-05 cohort summaries. Direct uses the independently measured U4/min32/M16 HC128 optional build. Each comparison shows SYCL, L0 and Direct in tok/s. Percentages compare each candidate rate with SYCL. Bars use forward summaries; labels include both orders. This is a cross-cohort throughput ratio, not a concurrent three-backend bracket; L0 reverse Code prefill drift exceeds 3%. Ranges are cohort summaries, not confidence intervals. Warm requests exclude process startup, lazy first loading and HTTP. Direct remains WIP, Linux GPU unvalidated, U4 model uploads deferred.
